title: Binance Futures to Support BFUSD on Portfolio Margin Accounts
text: This is a general and marketing announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Starting from  2024-12-20 08:00 (UTC),  Binance Futures will support BFUSD on Portfolio Margin and Portfolio Margin Pro accounts. Users will be able to: Buy and redeem BFUSD, and Use BFUSD as margin in Cross Margin, USDⓈ-M Futures, and COIN-M Futures trading. For more details on using BFUSD margin, refer to  Trading Rules . Portfolio Margin users can buy and redeem BFUSD via the following APIs: Buy BFUSD:  POST /sapi/v1/portfolio/mint Redeem BFUSD:  POST /sapi/v1/portfolio/redeem Note: Buying and redeeming of BFUSD via API is only supported for Portfolio Margin accounts. Classic trading accounts cannot buy and redeem BFUSD via API.
